translationEn: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓي اَنْ يُّحْيِۦَ الْمَوْتٰى ۝٤٠ࣖ
translationEn: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

arabicTextUthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: هَلْ اَتٰي عَلَي الْاِنْسَانِ حِيْنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُوْرًا ۝١
translationEn: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجٍࣗۖ نَّبْتَلِيْهِ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ سَمِيْعًاۢ بَصِيْرًا ۝٢
translationEn: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا هَدَيْنٰهُ السَّبِيْلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوْرًا ۝٣
translationEn: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَاَغْلٰلًا وَّسَعِيْرًا ۝٤
translationEn: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُوْنَ مِنْ كَاْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوْرًا ۝٥ۚ
translationEn: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,

arabicTextUthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: عَيْنًا يَّشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوْنَهَا تَفْجِيْرًا ۝٦
translationEn: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

arabicTextUthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: يُوْفُوْنَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُوْنَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسْتَطِيْرًا ۝٧
translationEn: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيُطْعِمُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰي حُبِّهٖ مِسْكِيْنًا وَّيَتِيْمًا وَّاَسِيْرًا ۝٨
translationEn: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيْدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَا࢜ءً وَّلَا شُكُوْرًا ۝٩
translationEn: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوْسًا قَمْطَرِيْرًا ۝١٠
translationEn: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

arabicTextUthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَوَقٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقّٰىهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَّسُرُوْرًا ۝١١ۚ
translationEn: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَجَزٰىهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيْرًا ۝١٢ۙ
translationEn: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

arabicTextUthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: مُّتَّكِـِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا عَلَي الْاَرَا࢜ىِٕكِۚ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيْهَا شَمْسًا وَّلَا زَمْهَرِيْرًا ۝١٣ۚ
translationEn: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

arabicTextUthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِيْلًا ۝١٤
translationEn: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيْرَا۟ؔ ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

arabicTextUthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: قَوَارِيْرَا۟ؔ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوْهَا تَقْدِيْرًا ۝١٦
translationEn: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيْهَا كَاْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِيْلًا ۝١٧ۚ
translationEn: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

arabicTextUthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: عَيْنًا فِيْهَا تُسَمّٰي سَلْسَبِيْلًا ۝١٨
translationEn: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

arabicTextUthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوْنَۚ اِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُو͏ٔ͏ْلُو͏ٔ͏ًا مَّنْثُوْرًا ۝١٩
translationEn: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيْتَ نَعِيْمًا وَّمُلْكًا كَبِيْرًا ۝٢٠
translationEn: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

arabicTextUthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: عٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٌؗ وَّحُلُّوْٓا اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍۚ وَسَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُوْرًا ۝٢١
translationEn: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَا࢜ءً وَّكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا ۝٢٢ࣖ
translationEn: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَنْزِيْلًا ۝٢٣ۚ
translationEn: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ اٰثِمًا اَوْ كَفُوْرًا ۝٢٤ۚ
translationEn: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًا ۝٢٥ۖۚ
translationEn: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

arabicTextUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيْلًا ۝٢٦
translationEn: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ يُحِبُّوْنَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوْنَ وَرَا࢜ءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيْلًا ۝٢٧
translationEn: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

arabicTextUthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا͏ٓ اَسْرَهُمْۚ وَاِذَا شِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا بَدَّلْنَا͏ٓ اَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيْلًا ۝٢٨
translationEn: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا ۝٢٩
translationEn: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا تَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا ۝٣٠ࣗۖ
translationEn: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

arabicTextUthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
arabicTextIndoPak: يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمِيْنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا ۝٣١ࣖ
translationEn: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْمُرْسَلٰتِ عُرْفًا ۝١ۙ
translationEn: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَالْعٰصِفٰتِ عَصْفًا ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And the winds that blow violently

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّالنّٰشِرٰتِ نَشْرًا ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَالْفٰرِقٰتِ فَرْقًا ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: And those [angels] who bring criterion

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَالْمُلْقِيٰتِ ذِكْرًا ۝٥ۙ
translationEn: And those [angels] who deliver a message

arabicTextUthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: عُذْرًا اَوْ نُذْرًا ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: As justification or warning,

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لَوَاقِعٌ ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِذَا النُّجُوْمُ طُمِسَتْ ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: So when the stars are obliterated

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا السَّمَا࢜ءُ فُرِجَتْ ۝٩ۙ
translationEn: And when the heaven is opened

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ ۝١٠ۙ
translationEn: And when the mountains are blown away

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الرُّسُلُ اُقِّتَتْ ۝١١ؕ
translationEn: And when the messengers' time has come...

arabicTextUthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translationEn: For what Day was it postponed?

arabicTextUthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
arabicTextIndoPak: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ ۝١٣ۚ
translationEn: For the Day of Judgement.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَدْرٰىكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۝١٤ؕ
translationEn: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝١٥
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْاٰخِرِيْنَ ۝١٧
translationEn: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

arabicTextUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِيْنَ ۝١٨
translationEn: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝١٩
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُّمْ مِّنْ مَّا࢜ءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۝٢٠ۙ
translationEn: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

arabicTextUthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَجَعَلْنٰهُ فِيْ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيْنٍ ۝٢١ۙ
translationEn: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

arabicTextUthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِلٰي قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ ۝٢٢ۙ
translationEn: For a known extent.

arabicTextUthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَقَدَرْنَاࣗۖ فَنِعْمَ الْقٰدِرُوْنَ ۝٢٣
translationEn: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٢٤
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْاَرْضَ كِفَاتًا ۝٢٥ۙ
translationEn: Have We not made the earth a container

arabicTextUthmani: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اَحْيَا࢜ءً وَّاَمْوَاتًا ۝٢٦ۙ
translationEn: Of the living and the dead?

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّجَعَلْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَّاَسْقَيْنٰكُمْ مَّا࢜ءً فُرَاتًا ۝٢٧ؕ
translationEn: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٢٨
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنْطَلِقُوْٓا اِلٰي مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ ۝٢٩ۚ
translationEn: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

arabicTextUthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنْطَلِقُوْٓا اِلٰي ظِلٍّ ذِيْ ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍ ۝٣٠ۙ
translationEn: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns

arabicTextUthmani: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
arabicTextIndoPak: لَّا ظَلِيْلٍ وَّلَا يُغْنِيْ مِنَ اللَّهَبِ ۝٣١ؕ
translationEn: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهَا تَرْمِيْ بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ ۝٣٢ۚ
translationEn: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

arabicTextUthmani: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَاَنَّهٗ جِمٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ ۝٣٣ؕ
translationEn: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٣٤
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: هٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُوْنَ ۝٣٥ۙ
translationEn: This is a Day they will not speak,

arabicTextUthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَلَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُوْنَ ۝٣٦
translationEn: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٣٧
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: هٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِۚ جَمَعْنٰكُمْ وَالْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝٣٨
translationEn: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيْدُوْنِ ۝٣٩
translationEn: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٤٠ࣖ
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ ظِلٰلٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۝٤١ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

arabicTextUthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُوْنَ ۝٤٢ؕ
translationEn: And fruits from whatever they desire,

arabicTextUthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كُلُوْا وَاشْرَبُوْا هَنِيْ࢜ـًٔاۢ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝٤٣
translationEn: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ ۝٤٤
translationEn: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٤٥
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كُلُوْا وَتَمَتَّعُوْا قَلِيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ مُّجْرِمُوْنَ ۝٤٦
translationEn: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٤٧
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوْا لَا يَرْكَعُوْنَ ۝٤٨
translationEn: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝٤٩
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabicTextUthmani: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَبِاَيِّ حَدِيْثٍۭ بَعْدَهٗ يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۝٥٠ࣖ
translationEn: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

arabicTextUthmani: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَمَّ يَتَسَا࢜ءَلُوْنَ ۝١ۚ
translationEn: About what are they asking one another?

arabicTextUthmani: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَنِ النَّبَاِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: About the great news -

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْ هُمْ فِيْهِ مُخْتَلِفُوْنَ ۝٣ؕ
translationEn: That over which they are in disagreement.

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: No! They are going to know.

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٥
translationEn: Then, no! They are going to know.

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْاَرْضَ مِهٰدًا ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّالْجِبَالَ اَوْتَادًا ۝٧ࣕۙ
translationEn: And the mountains as stakes?

arabicTextUthmani: وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّخَلَقْنٰكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: And We created you in pairs

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا ۝٩ۙ
translationEn: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّجَعَلْنَا الَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا ۝١٠ۙ
translationEn: And made the night as clothing

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا ۝١١ࣕ
translationEn: And made the day for livelihood

arabicTextUthmani: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا ۝١٢ۙ
translationEn: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَّهَّاجًا ۝١٣ࣕۙ
translationEn: And made [therein] a burning lamp

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّاَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرٰتِ مَا࢜ءً ثَجَّاجًا ۝١٤ۙ
translationEn: And sent down from the rain clouds pouring water

arabicTextUthmani: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
arabicTextIndoPak: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهٖ حَبًّا وَّنَبَاتًا ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

arabicTextUthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّجَنّٰتٍ اَلْفَافًا ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: And gardens of entwined growth.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيْقَاتًا ۝١٧ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
arabicTextIndoPak: يَّوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّوْرِ فَتَاْتُوْنَ اَفْوَاجًا ۝١٨ۙ
translationEn: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

arabicTextUthmani: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّفُتِحَتِ السَّمَا࢜ءُ فَكَانَتْ اَبْوَابًا ۝١٩ۙ
translationEn: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

arabicTextUthmani: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا ۝٢٠ؕ
translationEn: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا ۝٢١ࣕۙ
translationEn: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

arabicTextUthmani: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: لِّلطَّاغِيْنَ مَاٰبًا ۝٢٢ۙ
translationEn: For the transgressors, a place of return,

arabicTextUthmani: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: لّٰبِثِيْنَ فِيْهَا͏ٓ اَحْقَابًا ۝٢٣ۚ
translationEn: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

arabicTextUthmani: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا بَرْدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًا ۝٢٤ۙ
translationEn: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

arabicTextUthmani: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِلَّا حَمِيْمًا وَّغَسَّاقًا ۝٢٥ۙ
translationEn: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

arabicTextUthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
arabicTextIndoPak: جَزَا࢜ءً وِّفَاقًا ۝٢٦ؕ
translationEn: An appropriate recompense.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا لَا يَرْجُوْنَ حِسَابًا ۝٢٧ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

arabicTextUthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّكَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا ۝٢٨ؕ
translationEn: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

arabicTextUthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ اَحْصَيْنٰهُ كِتٰبًا ۝٢٩ۙ
translationEn: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

arabicTextUthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَذُوْقُوْا فَلَنْ نَّزِيْدَكُمْ اِلَّا عَذَابًا ۝٣٠ࣖ
translationEn: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ مَفَازًا ۝٣١ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

arabicTextUthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
arabicTextIndoPak: حَدَا࢜ىِٕقَ وَاَعْنَابًا ۝٣٢ۙ
translationEn: Gardens and grapevines

arabicTextUthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّكَوَاعِبَ اَتْرَابًا ۝٣٣ۙ
translationEn: And young women [companions] of equal age.

arabicTextUthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّكَاْسًا دِهَاقًا ۝٣٤ؕ
translationEn: And a full cup.

arabicTextUthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
arabicTextIndoPak: لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا لَغْوًا وَّلَا كِذّٰبًا ۝٣٥ۚ
translationEn: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

arabicTextUthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: جَزَا࢜ءً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ عَطَا࢜ءً حِسَابًا ۝٣٦ۙ
translationEn: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

arabicTextUthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا ۝٣٧ۚ
translationEn: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الرُّوْحُ وَالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ صَفًّاؕࣗۙ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُوْنَ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا ۝٣٨
translationEn: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

arabicTextUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
arabicTextIndoPak: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّۚ فَمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ مَاٰبًا ۝٣٩
translationEn: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَنْذَرْنٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيْبًا࣢ۚۖ يَّوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدٰهُ وَيَقُوْلُ الْكٰفِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ كُنْتُ تُرٰبًا ۝٤٠ࣖ
translationEn: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالنّٰزِعٰتِ غَرْقًا ۝١ۙ
translationEn: By those [angels] who extract with violence

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّالنّٰشِطٰتِ نَشْطًا ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And [by] those who remove with ease

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّالسّٰبِحٰتِ سَبْحًا ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَالسّٰبِقٰتِ سَبْقًا ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: And those who race each other in a race

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَالْمُدَبِّرٰتِ اَمْرًا ۝٥ۘ
translationEn: And those who arrange [each] matter,

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

arabicTextUthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
arabicTextIndoPak: تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

arabicTextUthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: قُلُوْبٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ وَّاجِفَةٌ ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

arabicTextUthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ ۝٩ۘ
translationEn: Their eyes humbled.

arabicTextUthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَقُوْلُوْنَ ءَاِنَّا لَمَرْدُوْدُوْنَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ ۝١٠ؕ
translationEn: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

arabicTextUthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
arabicTextIndoPak: ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَّخِرَةً ۝١١ؕ
translationEn: Even if we should be decayed bones?"

arabicTextUthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: قَالُوْا تِلْكَ اِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ ۝١٢ۘ
translationEn: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ ۝١٣ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِذَا هُمْ بِالسَّاهِرَةِ ۝١٤ؕ
translationEn: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

arabicTextUthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيْثُ مُوْسٰي ۝١٥ۘ
translationEn: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

arabicTextUthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذْ نَادٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًي ۝١٦ۚ
translationEn: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

arabicTextUthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذْهَبْ اِلٰي فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰي ۝١٧ؗۖ
translationEn: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

arabicTextUthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَقُلْ هَلْ لَّكَ اِلٰٓي اَنْ تَزَكّٰي ۝١٨ۙ
translationEn: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَهْدِيَكَ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشٰي ۝١٩ۚ
translationEn: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَرٰىهُ الْاٰيَةَ الْكُبْرٰي ۝٢٠ؗۖ
translationEn: And he showed him the greatest sign,

arabicTextUthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translationEn: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ اَدْبَرَ يَسْعٰي ۝٢٢ؗۖ
translationEn: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].

arabicTextUthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادٰي ۝٢٣ؗۖ
translationEn: And he gathered [his people] and called out

arabicTextUthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَقَالَ اَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْاَعْلٰي ۝٢٤ؗۖ
translationEn: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَخَذَهُ اللّٰهُ نَكَالَ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَالْاُوْلٰي ۝٢٥ؕ
translationEn: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَنْ يَّخْشٰي ۝٢٦ؕࣖ
translationEn: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

arabicTextUthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: ءَاَنْتُمْ اَشَدُّ خَلْقًا اَمِ السَّمَا࢜ءُؕ بَنٰىهَا ۝٢٧ۙ
translationEn: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

arabicTextUthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوّٰىهَا ۝٢٨ۙ
translationEn: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَاَخْرَجَ ضُحٰىهَا ۝٢٩ࣕ
translationEn: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ دَحٰىهَا ۝٣٠ؕ
translationEn: And after that He spread the earth.

arabicTextUthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: اَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَا࢜ءَهَا وَمَرْعٰىهَا ۝٣١ࣕ
translationEn: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْجِبَالَ اَرْسٰىهَا ۝٣٢ۙ
translationEn: And the mountains He set firmly

arabicTextUthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
arabicTextIndoPak: مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِاَنْعَامِكُمْ ۝٣٣ؕ
translationEn: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِذَا جَا࢜ءَتِ الطَّا࢜مَّةُ الْكُبْرٰي ۝٣٤ؗۖ
translationEn: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْاِنْسَانُ مَا سَعٰي ۝٣٥ۙ
translationEn: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

arabicTextUthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيْمُ لِمَنْ يَّرٰي ۝٣٦
translationEn: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَمَّا مَنْ طَغٰي ۝٣٧ۙ
translationEn: So as for he who transgressed

arabicTextUthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاٰثَرَ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا ۝٣٨ۙ
translationEn: And preferred the life of the world,

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِنَّ الْجَحِيْمَ هِيَ الْمَاْوٰي ۝٣٩ؕ
translationEn: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهٖ وَنَهَي النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوٰي ۝٤٠ۙ
translationEn: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَاْوٰي ۝٤١ؕ
translationEn: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

arabicTextUthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: يَسْـَٔلُوْنَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ اَيَّانَ مُرْسٰىهَا ۝٤٢ؕ
translationEn: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

arabicTextUthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِيْمَ اَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرٰىهَا ۝٤٣ؕ
translationEn: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

arabicTextUthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِلٰي رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهٰىهَا ۝٤٤ؕ
translationEn: To your Lord is its finality.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ مَنْ يَّخْشٰىهَا ۝٤٥ؕ
translationEn: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

arabicTextUthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
arabicTextIndoPak: كَاَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِيَّةً اَوْ ضُحٰىهَا ۝٤٦ࣖ
translationEn: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

arabicTextUthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلّٰٓي ۝١ۙ
translationEn: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

arabicTextUthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَنْ جَا࢜ءَهُ الْاَعْمٰى ۝٢ؕ
translationEn: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا يُدْرِيْكَ لَعَلَّهٗ يَزَّكّٰٓي ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified

arabicTextUthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنْفَعَهُ الذِّكْرٰى ۝٤ؕ
translationEn: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

arabicTextUthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنٰى ۝٥ۙ
translationEn: As for he who thinks himself without need,

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَنْتَ لَهٗ تَصَدّٰى ۝٦ؕ
translationEn: To him you give attention.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ اَلَّا يَزَّكّٰى ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَمَّا مَنْ جَا࢜ءَكَ يَسْعٰى ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

arabicTextUthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَهُوَ يَخْشٰى ۝٩ۙ
translationEn: While he fears [Allāh],

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَنْتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهّٰى ۝١٠ۚ
translationEn: From him you are distracted.

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ ۝١١ۚ
translationEn: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

arabicTextUthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ ذَكَرَهٗ ۝١٢ۘ
translationEn: So whoever wills may remember it.

arabicTextUthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translationEn: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

arabicTextUthmani: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translationEn: Exalted and purified,

arabicTextUthmani: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: بِاَيْدِيْ سَفَرَةٍ ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

arabicTextUthmani: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: Noble and dutiful.

arabicTextUthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: قُتِلَ الْاِنْسَانُ مَا͏ٓ اَكْفَرَهٗ ۝١٧ؕ
translationEn: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.

arabicTextUthmani: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: مِنْ اَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ ۝١٨ؕ
translationEn: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?

arabicTextUthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍؕ خَلَقَهٗ فَقَدَّرَهٗ ۝١٩ۙ
translationEn: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ السَّبِيْلَ يَسَّرَهٗ ۝٢٠ۙ
translationEn: Then He eased the way for him;

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ اَمَاتَهٗ فَاَقْبَرَهٗ ۝٢١ۙ
translationEn: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ اِذَا شَا࢜ءَ اَنْشَرَهٗ ۝٢٢ؕ
translationEn: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا͏ٓ اَمَرَهٗ ۝٢٣ؕ
translationEn: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

arabicTextUthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْاِنْسَانُ اِلٰى طَعَامِهٖٓ ۝٢٤ۙ
translationEn: Then let mankind look at his food -

arabicTextUthmani: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا
arabicTextIndoPak: اَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَا࢜ءَ صَبًّا ۝٢٥ۙ
translationEn: How We poured down water in torrents,

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْاَرْضَ شَقًّا ۝٢٦ۙ
translationEn: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا فِيْهَا حَبًّا ۝٢٧ۙ
translationEn: And caused to grow within it grain

arabicTextUthmani: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّعِنَبًا وَّقَضْبًا ۝٢٨ۙ
translationEn: And grapes and herbage

arabicTextUthmani: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّزَيْتُوْنًا وَّنَخْلًا ۝٢٩ۙ
translationEn: And olive and palm trees

arabicTextUthmani: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّحَدَا࢜ىِٕقَ غُلْبًا ۝٣٠ۙ
translationEn: And gardens of dense shrubbery

arabicTextUthmani: وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّفَاكِهَةً وَّاَبًّا ۝٣١ۙ
translationEn: And fruit and grass -

arabicTextUthmani: مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
arabicTextIndoPak: مَّتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِاَنْعَامِكُمْ ۝٣٢ؕ
translationEn: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

arabicTextUthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاِذَا جَا࢜ءَتِ الصَّا࢜خَّةُ ۝٣٣ؗ
translationEn: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ اَخِيْهِ ۝٣٤ۙ
translationEn: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

arabicTextUthmani: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
translationEn: And his mother and his father

arabicTextUthmani: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَصَاحِبَتِهٖ وَبَنِيْهِ ۝٣٦ؕ
translationEn: And his wife and his children,

arabicTextUthmani: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
arabicTextIndoPak: لِكُلِّ امْرِي͏ٔ͏ٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ شَاْنٌ يُّغْنِيْهِ ۝٣٧ؕ
translationEn: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

arabicTextUthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وُجُوْهٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ ۝٣٨ۙ
translationEn: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

arabicTextUthmani: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ ۝٣٩ۚ
translationEn: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

arabicTextUthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَوُجُوْهٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ ۝٤٠ۙ
translationEn: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

arabicTextUthmani: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ ۝٤١ؕ
translationEn: Blackness will cover them.

arabicTextUthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
arabicTextIndoPak: اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ ۝٤٢ࣖ
translationEn: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

arabicTextUthmani: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ ۝١ࣕۙ
translationEn: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا النُّجُوْمُ انْكَدَرَتْ ۝٢ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ ۝٣ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the mountains are removed

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ ۝٤ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْوُحُوْشُ حُشِرَتْ ۝٥ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the wild beasts are gathered

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ ۝٦ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the seas are filled with flame

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا النُّفُوْسُ زُوِّجَتْ ۝٧ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the souls are paired

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْمَوْءٗدَةُ سُىِٕلَتْ ۝٨ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

arabicTextUthmani: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ
translationEn: For what sin she was killed

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ ۝١٠ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا السَّمَا࢜ءُ كُشِطَتْ ۝١١ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when the sky is stripped away

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْجَحِيْمُ سُعِّرَتْ ۝١٢ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْجَنَّةُ اُزْلِفَتْ ۝١٣ࣕۙ
translationEn: And when Paradise is brought near,

arabicTextUthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا͏ٓ اَحْضَرَتْ ۝١٤ؕ
translationEn: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

arabicTextUthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَلَا͏ٓ اُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: So I swear by the retreating stars -

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
arabicTextIndoPak: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ ۝١٦ۙ
translationEn: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا عَسْعَسَ ۝١٧ۙ
translationEn: And by the night as it closes in

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالصُّبْحِ اِذَا تَنَفَّسَ ۝١٨ۙ
translationEn: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهٗ لَقَوْلُ رَسُوْلٍ كَرِيْمٍ ۝١٩ۙ
translationEn: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

arabicTextUthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: ذِيْ قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِيْنٍ ۝٢٠ۙ
translationEn: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

arabicTextUthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ اَمِيْنٍ ۝٢١ؕ
translationEn: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُوْنٍ ۝٢٢ۚ
translationEn: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.

arabicTextUthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَلَقَدْ رَاٰهُ بِالْاُفُقِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۝٢٣ۚ
translationEn: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَي الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِيْنٍ ۝٢٤ۚ
translationEn: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطٰنٍ رَّجِيْمٍ ۝٢٥ۙ
translationEn: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَيْنَ تَذْهَبُوْنَ ۝٢٦ؕ
translationEn: So where are you going?

arabicTextUthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٢٧ۙ
translationEn: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

arabicTextUthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
arabicTextIndoPak: لِمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ مِنْكُمْ اَنْ يَّسْتَقِيْمَ ۝٢٨ؕ
translationEn: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا تَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٢٩ࣖ
translationEn: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

arabicTextUthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذَا السَّمَا࢜ءُ انْفَطَرَتْ ۝١ۙ
translationEn: When the sky breaks apart

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انْتَثَرَتْ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And when the stars fall, scattering,

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: And when the seas are erupted

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْقُبُوْرُ بُعْثِرَتْ ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

arabicTextUthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَاَخَّرَتْ ۝٥ؕ
translationEn: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

arabicTextUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْاِنْسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيْمِ ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكَ فَسَوّٰىكَ فَعَدَلَكَ ۝٧ۙ
translationEn: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

arabicTextUthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِيْٓ اَيِّ صُوْرَةٍ مَّا شَا࢜ءَ رَكَّبَكَ ۝٨ؕ
translationEn: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ بِالدِّيْنِ ۝٩ۙ
translationEn: No! But you deny the Recompense.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحٰفِظِيْنَ ۝١٠ۙ
translationEn: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

arabicTextUthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كِرَامًا كَاتِبِيْنَ ۝١١ۙ
translationEn: Noble and recording;

arabicTextUthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَعْلَمُوْنَ مَا تَفْعَلُوْنَ ۝١٢
translationEn: They know whatever you do.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ لَفِيْ نَعِيْمٍ ۝١٣ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِيْ جَحِيْمٍ ۝١٤ۚۖ
translationEn: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

arabicTextUthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَّصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّيْنِ ۝١٥
translationEn: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَا࢜ىِٕبِيْنَ ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: And never therefrom will they be absent.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَدْرٰىكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّيْنِ ۝١٧ۙ
translationEn: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ مَا͏ٓ اَدْرٰىكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّيْنِ ۝١٨ؕ
translationEn: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔاؕ وَالْاَمْرُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلّٰهِ ۝١٩ࣖ
translationEn: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِيْنَ ۝١ۙ
translationEn: Woe to those who give less [than due],

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا اكْتَالُوْا عَلَي النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُوْنَ ۝٢ؗۖ
translationEn: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا كَالُوْهُمْ اَوْ وَّزَنُوْهُمْ يُخْسِرُوْنَ ۝٣ؕ
translationEn: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ اَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوْثُوْنَ ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

arabicTextUthmani: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۝٥ۙ
translationEn: For a tremendous Day -

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَّوْمَ يَقُوْمُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٦ؕ
translationEn: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِيْ سِجِّيْنٍ ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَدْرٰىكَ مَا سِجِّيْنٌ ۝٨ؕ
translationEn: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

arabicTextUthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: كِتٰبٌ مَّرْقُوْمٌ ۝٩ؕ
translationEn: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيْلٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ ۝١٠ۙ
translationEn: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْنَ يُكَذِّبُوْنَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ ۝١١ؕ
translationEn: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهٖٓ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِيْمٍ ۝١٢ۙ
translationEn: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

arabicTextUthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذَا تُتْلٰي عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝١٣ؕ
translationEn: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا بَلْࣝ رَانَ عَلٰي قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ ۝١٤
translationEn: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لَّمَحْجُوْبُوْنَ ۝١٥ؕ
translationEn: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ اِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا الْجَحِيْمِ ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ ۝١٧ؕ
translationEn: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْاَبْرَارِ لَفِيْ عِلِّيِّيْنَ ۝١٨ؕ
translationEn: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَدْرٰىكَ مَا عِلِّيُّوْنَ ۝١٩ؕ
translationEn: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

arabicTextUthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translationEn: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

arabicTextUthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَّشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُوْنَ ۝٢١ؕ
translationEn: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ لَفِيْ نَعِيْمٍ ۝٢٢ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

arabicTextUthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَلَي الْاَرَا࢜ىِٕكِ يَنْظُرُوْنَ ۝٢٣ۙ
translationEn: On adorned couches, observing.

arabicTextUthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
arabicTextIndoPak: تَعْرِفُ فِيْ وُجُوْهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيْمِ ۝٢٤ۚ
translationEn: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

arabicTextUthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَّحِيْقٍ مَّخْتُوْمٍ ۝٢٥ۙ
translationEn: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

arabicTextUthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: خِتٰمُهٗ مِسْكٌؕ وَفِيْ ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُوْنَ ۝٢٦ؕ
translationEn: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمِزَاجُهٗ مِنْ تَسْنِيْمٍ ۝٢٧ۙ
translationEn: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

arabicTextUthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَيْنًا يَّشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُوْنَ ۝٢٨ؕ
translationEn: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اَجْرَمُوْا كَانُوْا مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا يَضْحَكُوْنَ ۝٢٩ؗۖ
translationEn: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا مَرُّوْا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُوْنَ ۝٣٠ؗۖ
translationEn: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا انْقَلَبُوْٓا اِلٰٓي اَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوْا فَكِهِيْنَ ۝٣١ؗۖ
translationEn: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا رَاَوْهُمْ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ لَضَا࢜لُّوْنَ ۝٣٢ۙ
translationEn: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا͏ٓ اُرْسِلُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ حٰفِظِيْنَ ۝٣٣ؕ
translationEn: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

arabicTextUthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُوْنَ ۝٣٤ۙ
translationEn: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

arabicTextUthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَلَي الْاَرَا࢜ىِٕكِۙ يَنْظُرُوْنَ ۝٣٥ؕ
translationEn: On adorned couches, observing.

arabicTextUthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوْا يَفْعَلُوْنَ ۝٣٦ࣖ
translationEn: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

arabicTextUthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذَا السَّمَا࢜ءُ انْشَقَّتْ ۝١ۙ
translationEn: When the sky has split [open]

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا الْاَرْضُ مُدَّتْ ۝٣ؕ
translationEn: And when the earth has been extended

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَلْقَتْ مَا فِيْهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ ۝٥ؕ
translationEn: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

arabicTextUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْاِنْسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلٰقِيْهِ ۝٦ۚ
translationEn: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ ۝٧ۙ
translationEn: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

arabicTextUthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَّسِيْرًا ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: He will be judged with an easy account

arabicTextUthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّيَنْقَلِبُ اِلٰٓي اَهْلِهٖ مَسْرُوْرًا ۝٩ؕ
translationEn: And return to his people in happiness.

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ وَرَا࢜ءَ ظَهْرِهٖ ۝١٠ۙ
translationEn: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

arabicTextUthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوْا ثُبُوْرًا ۝١١ۙ
translationEn: He will cry out for destruction

arabicTextUthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّيَصْلٰي سَعِيْرًا ۝١٢ؕ
translationEn: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فِيْٓ اَهْلِهٖ مَسْرُوْرًا ۝١٣ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translationEn: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

arabicTextUthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
arabicTextIndoPak: بَلٰٓيۚۛ اِنَّ رَبَّهٗ كَانَ بِهٖ بَصِيْرًا ۝١٥ؕ
translationEn: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

arabicTextUthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَلَا͏ٓ اُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ ۝١٦ۙ
translationEn: So I swear by the twilight glow

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ ۝١٧ۙ
translationEn: And [by] the night and what it envelops

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْقَمَرِ اِذَا اتَّسَقَ ۝١٨ۙ
translationEn: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

arabicTextUthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ ۝١٩ؕ
translationEn: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.

arabicTextUthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۝٢٠ۙ
translationEn: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِذَا قُرِي͏ٔ͏َ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْاٰنُ لَا يَسْجُدُوْنَ ۝٢١ࣛؕ
translationEn: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

arabicTextUthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا يُكَذِّبُوْنَ ۝٢٢ؗۖ
translationEn: But those who have disbelieved deny,

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوْعُوْنَ ۝٢٣ؗۖ
translationEn: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

arabicTextUthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ ۝٢٤ۙ
translationEn: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

arabicTextUthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍ ۝٢٥ࣖ
translationEn: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالسَّمَا࢜ءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوْجِ ۝١ۙ
translationEn: By the sky containing great stars

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُوْدِ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And [by] the promised Day

arabicTextUthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَشَاهِدٍ وَّمَشْهُوْدٍ ۝٣ؕ
translationEn: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

arabicTextUthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
arabicTextIndoPak: قُتِلَ اَصْحٰبُ الْاُخْدُوْدِ ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
arabicTextIndoPak: النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُوْدِ ۝٥ۙ
translationEn: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

arabicTextUthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُوْدٌ ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: When they were sitting near it.

arabicTextUthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّهُمْ عَلٰي مَا يَفْعَلُوْنَ بِالْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ شُهُوْدٌ ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا نَقَمُوْا مِنْهُمْ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَمِيْدِ ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيْدٌ ۝٩ؕ
translationEn: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ فَتَنُوا الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوْبُوْا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيْقِ ۝١٠ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ࣢ؕؔ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيْرُ ۝١١ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيْدٌ ۝١٢ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translationEn: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

arabicTextUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَهُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الْوَدُوْدُ ۝١٤ۙ
translationEn: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

arabicTextUthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
arabicTextIndoPak: ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيْدُ ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

arabicTextUthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيْدُ ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: Effecter of what He intends.

arabicTextUthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
arabicTextIndoPak: هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيْثُ الْجُنُوْدِ ۝١٧ۙ
translationEn: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

arabicTextUthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُوْدَ ۝١٨ؕ
translationEn: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

arabicTextUthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِيْ تَكْذِيْبٍ ۝١٩ۙ
translationEn: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّاللّٰهُ مِنْ وَّرَا࢜ىِٕهِمْ مُّحِيْطٌ ۝٢٠ۚ
translationEn: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.

arabicTextUthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْاٰنٌ مَّجِيْدٌ ۝٢١ۙ
translationEn: But this is an honored Qur’ān

arabicTextUthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِيْ لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوْظٍ ۝٢٢ࣖ
translationEn: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالسَّمَا࢜ءِ وَالطَّارِقِ ۝١ۙ
translationEn: By the sky and the knocker

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَدْرٰىكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And what can make you know what is the knocker?

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
arabicTextIndoPak: النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: It is the piercing star.

arabicTextUthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ ۝٤ؕ
translationEn: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

arabicTextUthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْاِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ ۝٥ؕ
translationEn: So let man observe from what he was created.

arabicTextUthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: خُلِقَ مِنْ مَّا࢜ءٍ دَافِقٍ ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

arabicTextUthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَّخْرُجُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَا࢜ىِٕبِ ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهٗ عَلٰي رَجْعِهٖ لَقَادِرٌ ۝٨ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

arabicTextUthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
arabicTextIndoPak: يَوْمَ تُبْلَي السَّرَا࢜ىِٕرُ ۝٩ۙ
translationEn: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

arabicTextUthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَّلَا نَاصِرٍ ۝١٠ؕ
translationEn: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالسَّمَا࢜ءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ ۝١١ۙ
translationEn: By the sky which sends back

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْاَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ ۝١٢ۙ
translationEn: And [by] the earth which splits,

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهٗ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ ۝١٣ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

arabicTextUthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ ۝١٤ؕ
translationEn: And it is not amusement.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّهُمْ يَكِيْدُوْنَ كَيْدًا ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translationEn: But I am planning a plan.

arabicTextUthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
arabicTextIndoPak: فَمَهِّلِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ اَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا ۝١٧ࣖ
translationEn: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

arabicTextUthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
arabicTextIndoPak: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلَي ۝١ۙ
translationEn: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ فَسَوّٰي ۝٢ࣕۙ
translationEn: Who created and proportioned

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالَّذِيْ قَدَّرَ فَهَدٰي ۝٣ࣕۙ
translationEn: And who destined and [then] guided

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالَّذِيْٓ اَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعٰي ۝٤ࣕۙ
translationEn: And who brings out the pasture

arabicTextUthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَجَعَلَهٗ غُثَا࢜ءً اَحْوٰي ۝٥ؕ
translationEn: And [then] makes it black stubble.

arabicTextUthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: سَنُقْرِي͏ٔ͏ُكَ فَلَا تَنْسٰٓي ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

arabicTextUthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِلَّا مَا شَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفٰي ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

arabicTextUthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرٰي ۝٨ۚۖ
translationEn: And We will ease you toward ease.

arabicTextUthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَذَكِّرْ اِنْ نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرٰي ۝٩ؕ
translationEn: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

arabicTextUthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translationEn: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

arabicTextUthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
arabicTextIndoPak: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْاَشْقَي ۝١١ۙ
translationEn: But the wretched one will avoid it –

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْ يَصْلَي النَّارَ الْكُبْرٰي ۝١٢ۚ
translationEn: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوْتُ فِيْهَا وَلَا يَحْيٰي ۝١٣ؕ
translationEn: Neither dying therein nor living.

arabicTextUthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكّٰي ۝١٤ۙ
translationEn: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

arabicTextUthmani: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهٖ فَصَلّٰي ۝١٥ؕ
translationEn: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

arabicTextUthmani: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
arabicTextIndoPak: بَلْ تُو͏ٔ͏ْثِرُوْنَ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا ۝١٦ۚۖ
translationEn: But you prefer the worldly life,

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَّاَبْقٰي ۝١٧ؕ
translationEn: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْاُوْلٰي ۝١٨ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

arabicTextUthmani: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
arabicTextIndoPak: صُحُفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰي ۝١٩ࣖ
translationEn: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

arabicTextUthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ
arabicTextIndoPak: هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيْثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ ۝١ؕ
translationEn: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

arabicTextUthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وُجُوْهٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

arabicTextUthmani: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: Working [hard] and exhausted.

arabicTextUthmani: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
arabicTextIndoPak: تَصْلٰي نَارًا حَامِيَةً ۝٤ۙ
translationEn: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

arabicTextUthmani: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: تُسْقٰي مِنْ عَيْنٍ اٰنِيَةٍ ۝٥ؕ
translationEn: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

arabicTextUthmani: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِيْعٍ ۝٦ۙ
translationEn: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

arabicTextUthmani: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِيْ مِنْ جُوْعٍ ۝٧ؕ
translationEn: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

arabicTextUthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وُجُوْهٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ ۝٨ۙ
translationEn: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

arabicTextUthmani: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ ۝٩ۙ
translationEn: With their effort [they are] satisfied

arabicTextUthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِيْ جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ ۝١٠ۙ
translationEn: In an elevated garden,

arabicTextUthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
arabicTextIndoPak: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيْهَا لَاغِيَةً ۝١١ؕ
translationEn: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

arabicTextUthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِيْهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ ۝١٢ۘ
translationEn: Within it is a flowing spring.

arabicTextUthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: فِيْهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوْعَةٌ ۝١٣ۙ
translationEn: Within it are couches raised high

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّاَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوْعَةٌ ۝١٤ۙ
translationEn: And cups put in place

arabicTextUthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوْفَةٌ ۝١٥ۙ
translationEn: And cushions lined up

arabicTextUthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوْثَةٌ ۝١٦ؕ
translationEn: And carpets spread around.

arabicTextUthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَفَلَا يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَي الْاِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ ۝١٧ࣟ
translationEn: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِلَي السَّمَا࢜ءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ ۝١٨ࣟ
translationEn: And at the sky - how it is raised?

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِلَي الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ ۝١٩ࣟ
translationEn: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

arabicTextUthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاِلَي الْاَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ ۝٢٠ࣟ
translationEn: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

arabicTextUthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translationEn: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

arabicTextUthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: لَسْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمُصَۜيْطِرٍ ۝٢٢ۙ
translationEn: You are not over them a controller.

arabicTextUthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِلَّا مَنْ تَوَلّٰي وَكَفَرَ ۝٢٣ۙ
translationEn: However, he who turns away and disbelieves –

arabicTextUthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللّٰهُ الْعَذَابَ الْاَكْبَرَ ۝٢٤ؕ
translationEn: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ اِلَيْنَا͏ٓ اِيَابَهُمْ ۝٢٥ۙ
translationEn: Indeed, to Us is their return.

arabicTextUthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
arabicTextIndoPak: ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ ۝٢٦ࣖ
translationEn: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالْفَجْرِ ۝١ۙ
translationEn: By the dawn

arabicTextUthmani: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ ۝٢ۙ
translationEn: And [by] ten nights

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ ۝٣ۙ
translationEn: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

arabicTextUthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَالَّيْلِ اِذَا يَسْرِ ۝٤ۚ
translationEn: And [by] the night when it passes,

arabicTextUthmani: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: هَلْ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِيْ حِجْرٍ ۝٥ؕ
translationEn: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

arabicTextUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ ۝٦ࣕۙ
translationEn: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -

arabicTextUthmani: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ ۝٧ࣕۙ
translationEn: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّتِيْ لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ ۝٨ࣕۙ
translationEn: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

arabicTextUthmani: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَثَمُوْدَ الَّذِيْنَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ ۝٩ࣕۙ
translationEn: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

arabicTextUthmani: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْاَوْتَادِ ۝١٠ࣕۙ
translationEn: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?

arabicTextUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
arabicTextIndoPak: الَّذِيْنَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ ۝١١ࣕۙ
translationEn: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَكْثَرُوْا فِيْهَا الْفَسَادَ ۝١٢ࣕۙ
translationEn: And increased therein the corruption.

arabicTextUthmani: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ ۝١٣ۚۙ
translationEn: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

arabicTextUthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
arabicTextIndoPak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ ۝١٤ؕ
translationEn: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

arabicTextUthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
arabicTextIndoPak: فَاَمَّا الْاِنْسَانُ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَاَكْرَمَهٗ وَنَعَّمَهٗ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوْلُ رَبِّيْٓ اَكْرَمَنِ ۝١٥ؕ
translationEn: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

arabicTextUthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَاَمَّا͏ٓ اِذَا مَا ابْتَلٰىهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهٗ࣢ۙ فَيَقُوْلُ رَبِّيْٓ اَهَانَنِ ۝١٦ۚ
translationEn: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

arabicTextUthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
arabicTextIndoPak: كَلَّا بَلْ لَّا تُكْرِمُوْنَ الْيَتِيْمَ ۝١٧ۙ
translationEn: No! But you do not honor the orphan

arabicTextUthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
arabicTextIndoPak: وَلَا تَحٰ࢜ضُّوْنَ عَلٰي طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِيْنِ ۝١٨ۙ
translationEn: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

arabicTextUthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَتَاْكُلُوْنَ التُّرَاثَ اَكْلًا لَّمًّا ۝١٩ۙ
translationEn: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

arabicTextUthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
arabicTextIndoPak: وَّتُحِبُّوْنَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا ۝٢٠ؕ
